data.name: Mind Within
data.detailed_description:
Mind Within

Crafted by Helix Interactive Studios

Mind Within is a psychological adventure game that takes you deep into the human mind—where imagination, memory, and trauma intertwine. Navigate surreal dreamscapes, solve layered puzzles, and face haunting manifestations of the subconscious as you uncover a deeply personal story of resilience and recovery.

You play as a young protagonist trapped within their own psyche, piecing together forgotten moments and confronting fears through exploration, stealth mechanics, and emotional storytelling. Each level represents a different layer of the mind, blending stylized visuals with dynamic gameplay that challenges both logic and emotion.

But Mind Within isn’t just about escape—it’s about understanding.

🔍 Key Features

  • Narrative-Driven Gameplay: Dive into a rich psychological story told through symbolic environments and immersive voice acting.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Every level is a handcrafted mental landscape filled with hidden meanings and secrets.

  • Dynamic Puzzle Design: Solve intuitive and story-integrated puzzles that evolve with your character's journey.

  • Stealth and Survival: Avoid manifestations of fear in tense sequences where your choices matter.

  • Original Soundtrack: A haunting and emotional score that adapts with the narrative.

👾 Who We Are

Mind Within is developed by Helix Interactive Studios, an indie team passionate about combining storytelling with meaningful gameplay. We also teach game development—follow us for behind-the-scenes tutorials, breakdowns, and devlogs.

Stream. Develop. Play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: windows 8
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4,096 MB (4 GB) MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15,360 MB (15 GB) MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required; controller optional
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8,192 MB (8 GB) MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15,360 MB (15 GB) MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for best experience
